The planted patch is the exact inverse of the change. Pictures near_lamp_plug_on_strip BEFORE and AFTER read: one orange plug stacked on the strip's right socket plug before, gone after, cords unchanged. The repaired checks weaken nothing: V.shot asks a fresh game file name and still copies to the same name; wall_plug_look exits 2 when a stand was not staged.
